from: A stranger: AGI means dark headlines; solarpunk is a word they have never heard

sections.title: Everyone tells you how it ends
sections.how: The dark story said out loud, then the green one: with AGI it becomes real
sections.to: Stopped. Sceptical, but they want it to be true

sections.title: The trailer
sections.how: The real place, the person, the game's map turning into the city
sections.to: It is a real plan with a face. But better how?

sections.title: A hundred times better
sections.how: Hey Maia, how does it start? The wish to live in nature, round a food forest
sections.to: The wish is theirs too. But a game has nothing to plant in yet

sections.title: Ask for a river
sections.how: He asks for water, Maia builds a ditch; he says why; it becomes a river
sections.to: Surprised: this is quick, and it works

sections.title: The tree that failed
sections.how: Maia fails the pine three times; only his eye on a photo gets it right
sections.to: It is not magic: it takes both. They trust it more

sections.title: This was one day
sections.how: One rise from the forest floor to the clouds: all of it made today
sections.to: If this is one day, the dream is buildable. Ready for the first plant

sections.title: The first gust
sections.how: The light goes; the tent's canvas begins to move
sections.to: They have to know if the tent holds. Back tomorrow
